networkError: No connection to AIONEX. Check your internet and try again.
sessionExpired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
ownerConsoleOnly: This account signs in from the owner console only.
deviceCompromised: This device looks modified (rooted, jailbroken or running hooking tools). Your account stays protected by the server, but payments are turned off on this device.
scanOrOpen: Scan the code with your authenticator app, or open it directly on this phone, then enter the 6-digit code.
registerOnWebsite: Account creation on the web is done on the website.
pushEnabled: Notifications are on for this phone.
pushDenied: Notifications are off for AIONEX in the phone settings.
realtimePlanTitle: Live rooms need a paid plan
socialConnectOnWebsite: New accounts are connected on the website with Meta's official login. Come back and refresh afterwards.
adsOnWebsite: Linking ad accounts and creating campaigns happen on the website. Here you follow performance and pause or activate your campaigns.
deleteAccountBody: This permanently deletes your account: your personal details are removed, every device is signed out, and if you are the only member of your organization its projects and the organization are closed. A web subscription is cancelled at once. This cannot be undone.
deleteAccountStoreWarning: You have an app store subscription. Deleting the account does not cancel it: cancel it yourself in the store settings so you are not charged again.
accountDeleted: Your account was deleted. Thank you for using AIONEX.
deleteAccountOwnerHasMembers: You own an organization with other members. Transfer ownership or remove the members first.
socialSignUpNote: Finish creating your account. Your email comes from {provider} and cannot be changed here.
remediationRequested: Fix requested. Its status appears in the Security Lab.
remediationUnavailable: Automatic fixes are only available for AIONEX projects enabled by the platform owner.
